title: Looking to the future
description: With the implementation of Order 66, Jedi warriors across the galaxy were slain in an unprecedented bloodbath. Now the evil Emperor Palpatine, a.k.a. Darth Sidious, reigns supreme, ruling the known cosmos with an iron fist. But the enemies of tyranny are not idle. Forced into exile but hardly vanquished, Yoda and Obi-Wan Kenobi take significant steps toward ensuring a brighter tomorrow. The twin children of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala are whisked out of harm's way and placed in families that will love and protect them. Someday, perhaps sooner than the Emperor thinks, the sins of the father will be re-visited by their offspring...and a bright, new hope will emerge.
